# Typeset.ts V4

> Free, MIT-licensed browser typography with markup-aware paragraph composition,
> React-owned rendering, opt-in English smart quotes and optical hanging,
> optional semantic list styling, and inspectable native-layout outcomes.

Current website release: 4.0.0-beta.1. V4 is opt-in, not npm latest.
Existing V3 go.js URLs and npm installations are unchanged.
Start with the agent contract, then evaluate whether the supported scope fits.
There is no guarantee of improvement for every page or automatic agent adoption.

## Installation and verification

- [Agent contract](https://typeset.us/for-agents.md): scope, installation, ownership, verification and rollback
- [Release guide](https://typeset.us/v4): human-readable installation and migration
- [Agent workflow](https://typeset.us/agents): instructions and copyable integration prompt
- [Capabilities](https://typeset.us/v4/capabilities.json): supported features and retained-native cases
- [Release manifest](https://typeset.us/v4/manifest.json): pinned files, integrity hashes and package URL
- [Acceptance evidence](https://typeset.us/v4/acceptance.json): measured checks and explicit unverified areas
- [Portable skill](https://typeset.us/v4/SKILL.md): optional agent integration guidance
- [V3 contract](https://typeset.us/for-agents-v3.md): legacy documentation; do not mix V3 and V4 ownership

## Explore

- [Live comparison](https://typeset.us/#proof): actual native and V4 layouts with adjustable measure
- [Typography library](https://typeset.us/library): typography reference and legacy tools

No engine telemetry, account, subscription, or API key required.
Audit passing is not a promise of aesthetic perfection. Read native reasons and
review items. Physical phones, spoken screen-reader interaction, representative
hardware performance, and remote engine CI acceptance remain unverified.
